answer: Because the timing is recorded against the basalt challenge, the ivory audit can replay the ridge history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm hence has to pad 272 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 2999 identities would post 526 proofs and burn roughly 56 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
